key.name: auto-switch
key.description: When monitors are connected or disconnected, automatically apply the saved layout that matches the now-connected monitors.

key.name: default-layout
key.description: Name of the layout to prefer when several saved layouts match the connected monitors during auto-switch. Set via "Set as default".

key.name: cycle-layouts
key.summary: Cycle to the next saved layout
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that applies the next saved layout in order.
